comment: Compact 8-type MBTI feature dataset. I/E has been removed by combining each introverted type with its extraverted counterpart: INTJ+ENTJ -> NTJ, INTP+ENTP -> NTP, INFJ+ENFJ -> NFJ, INFP+ENFP -> NFP, ISTJ+ESTJ -> STJ, ISFJ+ESFJ -> SFJ, ISTP+ESTP -> STP, ISFP+ESFP -> SFP. Tokens are stored once per group; each 8-type row stores probability arrays aligned to the token list.

keyboardInitial.comment: Initial keyboard-character model. Text is processed as raw characters. Every keyboard character is counted exactly as written, including case, punctuation, spaces, tabs, and newlines. Characters outside the keyboard vocabulary are mapped to OTHER if OTHER exists in the model.

keyboardFull.comment: Full downloaded-data keyboard-character model. Text is processed as raw characters. This group is scored separately from keyboardInitial and only aggregated at the end.

lowerSpacePairsFull.comment: Lowercase-space adjacent-pair model. Text is NFKC-normalized, lowercased, reduced to lowercase a-z plus spaces, repeated spaces are collapsed, edge spaces are stripped, then overlapping two-character pairs are counted. Example: 'Hi, Bob!' becomes 'hi bob', then pairs like 'hi', 'i ', ' b', 'bo', 'ob'.

lastLetterPunctuationFull.comment: Last-letter-plus-punctuation model. Text is NFKC-normalized and lowercased. Only adjacent pairs where a lowercase letter is immediately followed by punctuation are counted, such as e, u! i. p; k' z?.

datasetDescription: Core MB3I family model with I/E collapsed into 8 type-families.
